messages.content: Can you list some horror movies I can watch?

function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | A masterful psychological thriller with iconic imagery and a chilling atmosphere. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A disturbing family saga that blends supernatural dread with raw emotional horror. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart, socially conscious horror that mixes satire with genuine scares. |
| 4 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | A psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood through a terrifying monster. |
| 5 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Suspenseful, low‑budget filmmaking that relies on sound (or the lack of it) to build tension. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A fresh take on the “invisible threat” trope with a haunting soundtrack. |
| 7 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | A daylight horror that turns a Swedish festival into a nightmare. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A well‑crafted supernatural thriller based on real‑life paranormal investigators. |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | A modern retelling of a Japanese horror classic that still feels fresh. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Low‑budget found‑footage that made a huge impact on the genre. |
|11 | **The Others** | 2001 | A gothic psychological thriller with a twist ending that keeps you guessing. |
|12 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑commentary on horror tropes that delivers both laughs and chills. |
|13 | **The Witch** | 2015 | A slow‑burn, atmospheric horror set in 17th‑century New England. |
|14 | **Suspiria** | 2018 | A visually stunning remake that amps up the supernatural terror. |
|15 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | A timeless classic that still terrifies audiences with its raw depiction of possession. |

Feel free to pick any that match your mood—whether you want a psychological thriller, supernatural scare, or something that plays with genre conventions. Happy watching!
